The passages describe the two machines differently, but they don't give a side-by-side comparison.

**Get Smart:** It is a smart card machine that runs Android. You can control stock, place orders, close accounts, load a menu and issue invoices directly on the device [1][4]. It can replace a computer and a fiscal printer at the counter [3]. Whether it prints NF-e depends on the app you choose [4].

**Get Clássica:** The page for this machine says it has:
- Free machine, account and card, if you meet the sales threshold of R$10,000 [5].
- Receipt in 2 days [5].
- A single rate for the main card brands [5].
- Support for both CPF and CNPJ customers [5].

The rates listed on that page are:
- Debit: 1.69%.
- Credit 1x: 3.79%.
- Credit 2x: 7.98% [5].

That page is from 2025 and may be out of date [5].

**Free machine thresholds:** The Get Clássica page says monthly sales of R$10 thousand earn a free Get Mini or Get Clássica. Sales of R$60 thousand are needed to include the Get Smart among the free options [5].

Receivables advance (antecipação de vendas) lets you receive the value of your credit-card sales early. This covers both lump-sum and installment sales, so you don't have to wait for the normal settlement period before the money reaches your account [6].

- **Timing:** A sale's schedule can be advanced from D+1, which is one business day after the sale. It stays available until D-3, which is three business days before the schedule settles into your account [7].
- **Example:** A sale made on 04/03 can be advanced from 05/03. If it would normally be credited on 03/04, it can be advanced until 31/03 [9].
- **Card brands:** Some card brands you've enabled can't be advanced through Getnet. For those, you have to go through the brand's own operator [7].
- **Automatic advance:** This is a condition for the exemption on the "Receba Conforme suas Vendas" receiving plan. It goes through credit approval, and Getnet assesses each contract individually [3].
- **E-commerce:** Advances on e-commerce sales are blocked for 6 months. Physical-store sales can still be advanced normally [5].
- **Collateral (gravame):** If you use your receivables as collateral for a loan, they are directed to the lender. With Getnet's loan, your sales from Getnet and other acquirers are paid into your Get Conta, up to the outstanding loan balance [1][2].

The passages don't give the advance fee rate.

2. **Run a communication test:** Press the function button (F, # or the one on your machine), select option 2 – maintenance, then option 1 – communication test [6].
3. **If the signal fluctuates (error ADQ 1-84):** Press Function, enter 25 (screen turns green), enter the Operator Password (green again), select Function 46 (green again), then make a test sale [4].

input.query: How many installments can a sale be split into with the crediário?
Can I sell through WhatsApp using the Payment Link?

content.text:
Yes. Getnet says sellers can send the Payment Link to their customers by social media, WhatsApp, email and SMS. The customer clicks the link, chooses a payment method and completes the purchase [1]. The Payment Link page also lists selling through WhatsApp or a social network as a benefit [2].

The customer can choose between debit, credit, Pix, Wallet and boleto [3]. Transactions made through the Payment Link must go through the antifraud check [5]. You don't need an active website to generate a link [5].

Up to 48 installments: the Crediário lets your customer split a purchase on a credit card in up to 48 times [1][3]. Interest rates can vary depending on the card issuer [1]. Each issuer also sets its own installment limit under its credit policies [2].

You can check the interest on the card machine before the sale. Insert the card, enter the amount, and choose credit > crediário. The machine can also print the simulation if it has a paper roll. The simulation is for reference only and is subject to credit analysis, so the card issuer decides whether to approve the transaction [2].

Yes, you can sell through WhatsApp with the Payment Link. Getnet says sellers can send the link to customers by social media, WhatsApp, email and SMS. The customer clicks the link, chooses a payment method and completes the purchase [sup-link-de-pagamento-12]. To check the interest before the sale, insert the card, enter the amount, and choose credit > crediário. If the machine has a paper roll, it can also print the simulation.
